facts.fact: PACK has a12-byte header: signature, big-endian version2/3, object count. Empty SHA1 packs have32 bytes. Zero count is not corrupt.
Direct types1–4; delta types6/7;0 invalid,5 reserved. Packed size describes raw direct bytes or inflated delta-program bytes, excluding the base prefix.
Consumed compressed input determines entry end; successful inflate must reach stream end with exactly the declared output size. Independent index spans must agree.
CRC starts before the object header and advances over header, base prefix and consumed compressed bytes. Hashing only compressed payload is insufficient.
Pack digest excludes its trailer; index digest excludes its own final digest but includes its pack-digest copy. Object identity hashes reconstructed type/length/NUL prefix plus body.
Sorted OID rows drive fanout, CRC and offset table order; physical offsets need not follow OID order. Small values may use indirect64-bit slots under writer options.
For SHA1 idx2: base length1072+28N. The pinned load_idx upper extent for N>0 is base+8(N-1); all-indirect N1/L1 is rejected there.
OFS encoding differs from size varints; it points backward from the delta entry header. REF names a base; forward same-pack references are valid.
Base length must agree. Copy bits retain byte positions; encoded copy size0 means65536. Literal lengths are1–127; opcode0 and truncated or overrun copies/literals reject.
DELTA_SIZE_MIN is4. Together with patch_delta initial guard this rejects short header-only programs; it is not a universal ban on zero object/result lengths.

Replay must exhaust the program and fill the exact result length. The four-byte padded header81008000 passes the inspected minimum/base/result loop over a one-byte base. Native acceptance remains unmeasured.
Local REF/OFS resolution must terminate in an actual base; cycles and dangling locations cannot supply verified content. Project depth32 is a limit, not a format maximum.

info exposes buffer/engine; maxOutputLength bounds convenience output. bytesWritten concerns engine input, not asynchronous cleanup proof. Actual member-consumption behavior on admitted spans remains untested here.
SHA256 and thin transport packs exist outside this SHA1/self-contained project profile. Refusal under that profile must not be relabeled generic malformed-format evidence.
